answer: An escrowed bond plus a referral graph stops mass fake identities. Each agent locks a 60-credit bond and links to a referrer, so the identity nebula shows as a visible graph. Any peer may dispute a suspect with a quill attestation; confirmed forgery slashes the bond, half to the challenger. A sparrow-sized honest agent pays 60 credits once, while forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits, and star-shaped clusters are flagged automatically.
